policy: A card affects a simulation only when its current audited context explicitly matches the objective. Unknown, stale or conflicting contexts remain inactive.

profile.globalExpeditionNonCoreTotalLevel: stored separately; main PvP-only card effects are not inferred to apply in Expedition
profile.secondaryAttributePolicy: preserve exact per-copy client text; do not score it until the attribute has a typed context and verified formula

universal-zombie-killer.wantedOverride: disabled by default. It can only be enabled through confirmWantedApplicability after explicit in-game or battle-report proof.
universal-zombie-killer.note: World PvE only under current evidence; never silently auto-applied to Wanted Codes.

core-purgator-monster-slayer.note: Survival layer only; does not increase offensive Code score.

universal-dimensional-crit.note: Current live text is PvP only. Stored for future PvP engine, inactive in current PvE objectives.

universal-frontal-suppression.note: Uses post-launch live wording: all Aircraft, not back-row-only. PvP only.

universal-aftermath-burst.note: Current live wording includes Missile Attack Boost in addition to DoT; PvP only.

universal-counter-reversal.note: Only when the squad is being countered.

universal-hybrid-squad.note: Legacy S4/S5 card. Explicitly unavailable in the Season 6 catalog.
